system.description:
• Effect: When you use your action to attack, make one additional weapon attack as part of it, with Disadvantage (see Extra attacks in The Arneyan Codex).
  • No Disadvantage against a creature next to one of your allies; your movement this turn then doesn't provoke Attacks of Opportunity from it.
  • Exploit still applies to only one attack per round.

activities.name: Cut and Run
activities.text: One additional weapon attack as part of your attack action, with Disadvantage that no Advantage cancels. Against a creature next to one of your allies, your movement this turn doesn't provoke Attacks of Opportunity from it. Exploit still applies to only one attack per round.

activities.name: Cut and Run (target next to an ally)
activities.text: No Disadvantage on the extra attack (target next to an ally). Against a creature next to one of your allies, your movement this turn doesn't provoke Attacks of Opportunity from it. Exploit still applies to only one attack per round.
